_doc: Task 6D section 17: ground-truth target geometry (box and point) for the Task 6C paired P training subset, the fixed 120-record validation set and the 20 paired validation images. This is the supervision/oracle geometry; inference never receives it.
box_definition: tight normalized (x1,y1,x2,y2) around the GT target mask, x1<=x2, y1<=y2
point_definition: maximum of the Euclidean distance transform inside the GT target mask, ties broken by row-major argmax
